==Notes==
* This is one of the few skills that can cause maximum health degeneration on its own.
* Cracked Armor does not need to be pre-applied to trigger the secondary effect. Degeneration occurs whenever a target suffers from this hex at the same time as Cracked Armor.
** For example, casting [[Teinai's Crystals]] after this skill will inflict all effects from both skills.

== Trivia ==
* This skill is named after the [[Canthan Heroes|Canthan hero]], [[Teinai]].
